title: Data Center HR Partner, AWS Builder Experience Team, BeXT
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Join Amazon's Builder Experience Team (BeXT) as a Data Center HR Partner and make every day better for the Builders who power AWS. This is a 100% on\-site role where you'll be embedded in the Data Centers you support, serving as the voice of Builders and the strategic HR partner to site leadership. You'll work across a cluster of Data Centers, visiting sites daily to ensure every Builder feels valued, engaged, and supported.
  

  

What we are looking for:  

* Adaptability. Manage multiple scenarios utilizing HR expertise, consulting skills, and influence.
* High Judgement. Exercise sound judgment in ambiguous situations. Serve as first point of escalation for Builder concerns.
* Strategic Thinking. Connect sentiment trends and HR data to bigger picture operational goals and translate them into clear recommendations that drive leadership action.
* Influencing. Influence multiple levels of the organization, from builders to senior site leaders, without direct authority.
* Coaching. Develop site leadership in the flow of work.

  

This is a 100% Onsite role and requires the ability to travel to assigned Data Center sites within an operational cluster (estimated 25% travel).  

* Data Center environments are 24/7 operational facilities; flexibility to support off\-shift populations and respond to time\-sensitive people matters is expected.
* This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports; leadership is demonstrated through influence, mentorship, and cross\-functional partnership.

  

Key job responsibilities  

Builder Advocacy: Build trust through consistent floor/onsite presence, site walks \& Gemba walks. Proactively monitor Builder sentiment trends using listening mechanisms. Support Builder queries with discretion and expertise. Foster and role model an environment of inclusion for all Builders, ensuring they feel fully engaged in their work and valued for who they are. Establish relationships with employee representative boards.  

  

Strategic Partnership: Partner with Data Center leaders at multiple levels to develop proactive strategies and goals focused on the Builder experience. Identify root causes using sentiment trends and HR data and provide site\-level recommendations to site leadership. Coordinate cluster\-wide communications in partnership with site leadership. Present at monthly All Manager and All Team Meetings.  

  

HR Expertise: Apply HR fundamentals to problem\-solve across talent management, performance management, compensation, and employee relations. Resolve complex cases independently, navigating Amazon Policies with high judgment. Conduct workplace investigations in collaboration with Builder Relations. Resolve systemic pay, internal transfer, and hiring defects in partnership with central teams. Build procedural policy/governance standards (e.g., SOPs).  

  

Leadership Development: Consult, coach, and develop site leadership through decision\-making with empathy and sound judgment. Identify development opportunities through data and anecdotal feedback from onsite floor walks and observation. Educate leaders on HR operating model standards. Support interviews for site manager and technical manager roles.  

  

Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Work with partner teams such as HRBPs and Centers of Excellence (COEs) to innovate, implement, and deploy HR strategies across your cluster of Data Centers. Partner with New Hire Experience teams on orientation and onboarding. Manage through ambiguity in a fast\-paced, continuously innovating environment.  

  

A day in the life  

You'll conduct weekly Gemba walks, engaging directly with Builders to understand their experience. You'll leverage Builder sentiment data to advocate for their needs, partnering with site leaders to develop proactive strategies focused on engagement. You'll consult and coach leadership through talent management, performance management, compensation decisions, and employee relations issues—applying empathy and sound judgment. You'll collaborate with stakeholders to align on Builder engagement actions. You'll conduct workplace investigations, manage Builder concerns as the first point of escalation, and own site\-specific people projects that drive impact.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Human Resources Management, Labor Relations, Business/Management, Psychology, or a related field
* 5\+ years of progressive HR experience, including experience in HR business partner, HR generalist, or HR site partner roles
* Experience supporting hourly/frontline populations of 100\+ employees in an operations or manufacturing environment
* Demonstrated experience in employee relations including conducting investigations and managing complex, high\-risk ER cases
* Working knowledge of local employment law

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience in data center, critical infrastructure, construction, or technology operations environments
* Experience supporting a multi\-site or multi\-cluster scope across a geographic region

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Incorta Architect
description:
**Job Description:**

**POSITION SUMMARY**

We are seeking an experienced Incorta Developer with 6–10 years of experience in enterprise reporting, analytics, and data modeling. The role will design scalable Incorta data models, develop complex dashboards and reports, integrate multiple source systems, and optimize analytical performance while partnering with business and data engineering teams.


**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Incorta Development and Data Modeling**

* Design and maintain Incorta physical schemas, business schemas, joins, materialized views, formula columns, measures, dimensions, and derived attributes.
* Configure ingestion jobs, data sources, pipelines, load plans, incremental refreshes, and data validation controls.
* Develop reusable semantic and dimensional models that support governed self\-service analytics.
* Translate complex business and reporting requirements into maintainable technical solutions.

**Reporting, Analytics, and Performance**

* Build complex operational, management, and executive dashboards and reports across multiple subject areas.
* Implement calculations, aggregations, filters, drilldowns, KPIs, exception reporting, and role\-based access.
* Troubleshoot and optimize queries, joins, formulas, schemas, ingestion patterns, and dashboard performance.
* Reconcile report outputs to source systems and resolve data quality or reporting discrepancies.

**Integration and Delivery**

* Integrate Incorta with ERP, CRM, WMS, TMS, finance, HR, and other enterprise source systems using database, API, file, or cloud\-based patterns.
* Work with data engineers on source mappings, transformations, data quality, refresh schedules, and lineage.
* Support design reviews, testing, UAT, defect resolution, releases, production support, and technical documentation.
* Provide mentoring and knowledge transfer to junior developers and report developers.

**REQUIRED SKILLS**

* 6–10 years in business intelligence, enterprise reporting, data analytics, or data warehousing, including substantial Incorta development experience.
* Strong hands\-on knowledge of Incorta schemas, ingestion, Analyzer, dashboards, security, materialized views, and performance tuning.
* Advanced SQL skills including complex joins, CTEs, window functions, aggregations, and performance\-aware query design.
* Strong understanding of semantic modeling, dimensional modeling, star/snowflake schemas, facts, dimensions, and slowly changing dimensions.
* Experience with ETL/ELT, data pipelines, source\-to\-target mappings, incremental loads, data profiling, and data governance.
* Experience with Oracle, SQL Server, Snowflake, PostgreSQL, or similar databases; familiarity with APIs, JSON/XML, and cloud data platforms.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, stakeholder\-management, and documentation skills.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Incorta certification or formal training; experience with Incorta Cloud.
* Experience with Power BI, Tableau, MicroStrategy, Cognos, or comparable BI tools.
* Experience delivering analytics for supply chain, finance, procurement, sales, operations, or HR.
* Experience with end\-to\-end reporting\-platform implementation, migration, or modernization.

**EDUCATION AND COMPETENCIES**

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Data Analytics, or a related field. A master’s degree or relevant certification is an advantage. The successful candidate demonstrates ownership, attention to data accuracy, structured problem solving, collaboration, and the ability to explain technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders.

title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer

The ideal candidate combines deep infrastructure engineering expertise with modern AI\-driven observability practices to deliver intelligent troubleshooting, automated instrumentation, proactive detection, and enterprise\-scale telemetry solutions. The engineer will partner with application teams, SREs, platform engineers, architects, and product leaders to expand observability adoption and accelerate incident detection and resolution.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design highly available, scalable, and resilient tracing solutions supporting enterprise workloads on SPLOC, AppDynamics, and Dynatrace platforms.
* Engineer cloud\-native observability solutions across Kubernetes, OpenShift, virtual machines, and hybrid environments.
* Develop and maintain tracing gateways, collectors, agents, and telemetry pipelines.
* Define and implement enterprise OpenTelemetry standards and instrumentation strategies.
* Enable automated instrumentation across Java, .NET, Node.js, Python, and emerging technology stacks.
* Design telemetry collection architectures using OpenTelemetry Collectors and modern observability patterns.
* Design and enable AI\-assisted troubleshooting capabilities.
* Evaluate and integrate AI agents for tracing, logging, performance analytics, and root\-cause determination.
* Partner with data and AI teams to build observability copilots and intelligent operational workflows.
* Automate agent deployment, upgrades, monitoring validation, and compliance checks.
* Build self\-service onboarding capabilities to accelerate application adoption.
* Serve as the technical lead for tracing and APM platforms.

**Required Qualifications:**

* 4\+ years of Technology Infrastructure Engineering and Solutions experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education

**Desired Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or related field.
* 3\+ years of experience in infrastructure engineering, platform engineering, SRE, or observability domains.
* 3\+ years of hands\-on experience with enterprise APM and tracing platforms: Splunk Observability Cloud (SignalFx/SPLOC), AppDynamics or Dynatrace
* Deep understanding of Distributed tracing, OpenTelemetry, Kubernetes/OpenShift

description:
### **When you join Verizon**


You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. ### **What you’ll be doing...**


We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Lead SAM Flexera Expert to play a crucial "player\-coach" role within our Software Asset Management (SAM) function. You will architect the end\-to\-end publisher management strategy while actively working as a hands\-on implementor for our most complex, tier\-1 software publishers within the Flexera One platform. In this role, you will drive enterprise\-wide continuous cost optimization programs, manually design and configure complex licensing frameworks, serve as the lead technical defender during major vendor audits, and mentor a team of SAM professionals.


Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

* Defining the end\-to\-end lifecycle strategy for software publishers within Flexera, while rolling up your sleeves to directly execute the onboarding, configuration, and compliance monitoring for critical tier\-1 vendors.
* Acting as the primary authority and hands\-on implementor for translating highly complex EULAs, MSAs, and amendments into accurate license records and product use rights (PUR) within the platform.
* Directing and executing continuous cost optimization initiatives, actively diving into the data to identify strategic opportunities regarding shelfware, hybrid cloud licensing, and enterprise\-wide application rationalization.
* Leading the defense and data strategy during major software vendor audits, collaborating closely with IT Procurement, Legal, and Sourcing teams to mitigate financial risk.
* Executing advanced data normalization, beacon management, and hands\-on troubleshooting of the Flexera architecture to ensure optimal platform health.
* Overseeing the strategic roadmap and technically supporting the implementation of Flexera integrations with enterprise systems like ServiceNow CMDB, cloud portals (AWS/Azure/GCP), and discovery tools.
* Mentoring and guiding SAM analysts by leading by example, fostering a culture of continuous ITAM process improvement and technical excellence.
* Developing and presenting executive\-level reporting on software compliance risk, ELP status, and realized cost savings.
* Collaborating with Sourcing and Legal teams to maintain continuously updated compliance workpapers, defend against vendor audits, and proactively support contract renewals.

### **What we’re looking for...**


You are a strategic leader and hands\-on technical expert with an authoritative understanding of software asset management and complex publisher licensing frameworks. You possess excellent problem\-solving skills, a proven ability to execute complex platform configurations, and a passion for mentoring others. You thrive when balancing high\-stakes compliance strategy with the technical implementation required to realize multi\-million\-dollar cost\-saving opportunities.

### **You’ll need to have:**

* 9\+ years of experience in Software Asset Management (SAM) or IT Asset Management (ITAM), with at least 5\+ years of dedicated, hands\-on implementation and architecture experience in Flexera.
* Proven leadership experience blending end\-to\-end publisher lifecycle strategy with direct, hands\-on platform execution.
* Expert\-level understanding of software licensing frameworks for major vendors (e.g., Microsoft, Oracle, IBM, Adobe, SAP, Red Hat, VMware/Broadcom).
* Extensive technical experience managing ecosystem integrations and databases, including ServiceNow CMDB, SQL queries, REST APIs, and discovery agent operations.
* Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex licensing data into actionable business strategies for leadership.

### **Even better if you have one or more of the following:**

* Flexera Certified Professional / Administrator (Flexera One / FNMS) and/or CSAM (Certified Software Asset Manager) or IAITAM certification.
* Scripting and automation skills (such as Python or PowerShell) to streamline API integrations and automate data management tasks.
* Understanding of how SAM intersects with Cybersecurity, specifically regarding the identification and management of End\-of\-Life (EOL) or End\-of\-Support (EOS) software to mitigate security risks.


If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.

title: EPM Solution Engineer
description:
**Company Description**  

SGS is the world’s leading Testing, Inspection and Certification company. We operate a network of over **2,500 laboratories and business facilities across 115 countries**, supported **by a team of over 100,000 dedicated professionals**. With **more than 145 years of service excellence**, we combine the precision and accuracy that define Swiss companies to help organizations achieve t**he highest standards of quality, compliance and sustainability.**


Our brand promise – **“when you need to be sure”** – underscores our commitment to **trust, integrity and reliability**, enabling businesses to **thrive with confidence**. We proudly deliver our **expert services** through the **SGS name** and a portfolio of **trusted specialized brands**, including **Applied Technical Services**, **Brightsight**, **Bluesign** and **Nutrasource**.

 **Job Description**  

As an **EPM Solution Engineer**, you will act as a key technical expert for SGS's Hyperion, Essbase and related EPM applications, driving their development, stability and continuous improvement. You will ensure solutions follow industry best practices for coding, architecture, security and performance while applying your expertise across the software development lifecycle.


You will play an active role in development and enhancement initiatives, ensuring business requirements are understood, challenged where necessary, and translated into scalable, sustainable solutions. You will assess the impact of new requirements and provide technical guidance that balances business needs with long\-term system integrity and maintainability.


You will oversee the maintenance and support of EPM applications, including metadata management, calculation scripts, business rules, reports and dashboards. Working closely with business stakeholders, IT teams and service providers, you will manage requests, support incident resolution and contribute to strategic initiatives such as platform upgrades, ERP transformation projects and the evolution of Oracle EPM solutions.

**Responsibilities**

* Oversee that the software development activity is carried out in accordance with SGS and market standards.
* Executes the validation of the technical designs \& oversees the application development activity and ensures that deliverables follow the defined \& market coding, architecture and security rules and guidelines.
* Ensuring that development estimates made by partners are reasonable and acceptable.
* Ensure that the development activities in the field of applications development and projects comply with the SGS technical standards and quality.
* Monitor 2nd or 3rd Level Support, working closely with AM Teams, business users, infrastructure team and application outsourcer (Oracle).
* Attend internal and external service meetings to discuss issues and improvement plans.
* Manage and monitor issues closely and ensure their resolution according to applicable escalation procedures.
* Perform regular service quality checks on incident tickets and requests and prepare improvement plans.
* Maintain the access and security configurations, ensuring the right level of control in line with the standards required by system auditors and internal controls.
* Monitor monthly maintenance activities: Maintain metadata, member list, FX Rates, business rules and validation checks.
* Support the year end Rollover activities, and support any other activity related financial closing.
* Oversee technical architecture activities such as patching, backups or application copies, working closely with DBA and infrastructure teams.
* Collaborate with Infrastructure teams, Solution Architects, Delivery managers and Application Outsourcers for any initiative that will require SGS engagement.

  

**Qualifications**  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* **Minimum 5 years’ experience in Hyperion or related EPM products** on any of the following processes:
	+ Financial Planning and Budgeting.
	+ Enterprise Data Management \& **Essbase**.
	+ Financial Consolidation and Closing.
	+ EPM Technical Architecture.
* Strong hands\-on experience with EPM development, including business rules, calculation scripts, metadata management and reporting.
* Experience supporting, enhancing and maintaining enterprise EPM applications.
* **Oracle EPM Cloud experience** is highly desirable.
* Experience with EPM upgrades, migrations or transformation initiatives is desirable.
* Strong understanding of IT Service Management (ITIL) principles.
* Ability to assess the impact of business requirements and communicate technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.

**Required Skills**

* Strong analytical, problem\-solving and troubleshooting skills.
* Ability to balance business requirements with long\-term system stability and architectural best practices.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Ability to influence decisions and provide trusted technical guidance.
* Collaborative, adaptable and comfortable working across global teams and external partners.
* Proactive, flexible and able to thrive in a fast\-paced environment.
* Embraces change and continuous improvement.

  

**Additional Information** **Why SGS?**

* Join a globally recognized and stable company, a leader in the Testing, Inspection, and Certification (TIC) industry.
* Enjoy a **flexible schedule and a hybrid work model.**
* Access continuous learning opportunities through SGS University and Campus.
* Collaborate in a multinational environment with colleagues from various continents.

**Apply Now**:  

At SGS, we are committed to fostering an open, friendly, and supportive culture that thrives on teamwork. We value diversity and provide endless opportunities to learn, grow your expertise, and fulfill your potential. Apply now to join our motivated and dynamic team!
